Earnest early spring news for anyone flying with an animal
The talk of the desk is lively
Calm Carry-on Notes from the Desk

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has had a steady run of cases, and the pattern is simple: careful checks, clear handoffs, and calm voices at the counter. Handlers are keeping to humane methods, supervisors are stepping in fast when a traveler looks uneasy, and the whole flow is holding up well across Aurelia Skyways.

Passengers bringing pets through our skyports can expect the same dependable routine and the same practical care. We keep the focus on smooth travel, steady reassurance, and tidy records, so each animal moves through the day with as little strain as possible. Companion Animal Travel Desk
